notes: transport_selfDual_fourB: statement unchanged (the pinned text again). Since SelfDual (M004788) now states the a.e. measurability of translations as an explicit conjunct, restoring its pinned meaning (#33373, option 1), its pinned statement read on the target has the pinned meaning; this is proved in Lean on the target (m074759_pinned_iff_target in M004788-DefEquiv.lean, linked from the PR). The extra conjuncts added by #33147 are dropped. The proof takes the translation conjunct out of SelfDual μ B (hsd.1.2), transports it along h.symm, and passes it to map_map_equiv_right. One statement change remains, forced: map_map_equiv_right gains the hypothesis hT : AEMeasurable T μ. Mathlib's Measure.map of a map that is not a.e. measurable changed from 0 to dirac Classical.ofNonempty for a nonzero measure (PORTING.md, reused-name table), and Measure.map_of_not_aemeasurable was removed. In the excluded case the pinned statement read 0 = 0 and had no content; on the target it reads dirac (e c) = dirac c' for the two chosen points, which fails (α = Bool with the trivial σ-algebra, T = id, e = Bool.not; negation proved in Lean on the target, #33147). It is a helper used only in this file. map_map_equiv_left: statement unchanged and still true for every g. When g is not a.e. measurable both sides are now the same Dirac mass (0 when μ = 0) instead of both 0; the proof uses map_of_not_aemeasurable_of_ne_zero and Measure.map_eq_zero_iff.
